component.name: NanoWeaver HRT Desktop
component.summary: Decentralized Synthetic Biology & DNA Origami Research Platform

description.p: NanoWeaver HRT is an open-source decentralized synthetic biology and DNA origami research platform designed for precision molecular engineering and patient-targeted hormone replacement therapy simulation.

ul.li: High-throughput molecular dynamics trajectory parsing and visualization
Endocrine kinetics simulation and multi-node federation
Secure cryptographic PKI manifests and verifiable dataset bundles

description.p: Initial stable release of NanoWeaver HRT Desktop.
